title: Impact of Chronic Pulmonary Aspergillosis (CPA) on Health Status and Well-being
official: Impact of Chronic Pulmonary Aspergillosis (CPA) on Health Status and Well-being
summary: To develop and validate a novel disease-specific questionnaire for measuring HRQoL in patients with Chronic Pulmonary Aspergillosis (CPA-HAQ) for use in clinical research, including clinical trials.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. All patients \>/= 18 years old and able to provide informed consent
2. Patients with a diagnosis of chronic pulmonary aspergillosis
3. To speak and understand English
4. Able to provide informed consent
